relatedStreams.title: Speaker's Unique Use of 'Alack' and Interactions with Fuwawa

This assertion is supported by multiple statements, including 'because who the fuck says alack', 'me', 'that's who', and 'I'm the only person in the world'. These quotes indicate a strong personal identification with the word 'alack', suggesting that the speaker views its use as a distinctive trait.
